claims.claim: An LLM game master accommodates even the most bizarre player requests with little regard for predetermined events, where a human GM would curb them.
claims.source: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)
claims.quote: accommodate for even the most bizarre requests
claims.page: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)

claims.claim: LLMs output plausible but false statements because they are a probable word sequence.
claims.source: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)
claims.page: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)

claims.claim: LLMs sometimes fail to capture user intent, especially sarcasm, and repeated clarification frustrates the player.
claims.source: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)
claims.quote: sometimes struggle to capture user intent
claims.page: Large Language Models and Games: A Survey and Roadmap (Gallotta et al.; v5 2024-12-09)

claims.claim: Pilot users of an LLM game master found story elements deviated from their intent and specific details changed, such as the number of enemies or items.
claims.source: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)
claims.quote: such as the number of enemies or items
claims.page: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)

claims.claim: Asked what the character was holding, the GM often gave incoherent answers and forgot items just picked up; performance worsened as the game continued.
claims.source: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)
claims.quote: the GM often provided incoherent responses
claims.page: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)

claims.claim: Unless actions were meticulously described, the prompt-engineered GM produced characters stumbling or self-injuring when it failed to identify a target.
claims.source: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)
claims.page: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)

claims.claim: Over-compliance in the GM role makes the game veer drastically from the intended narrative, potentially irreparably.
claims.source: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)
claims.quote: veering drastically from the intended narrative
claims.page: Static vs. Agentic Game Master AI for Facilitating Solo Role-Playing Experiences (ChatRPG; 2025-03-06)

claims.claim: Poorly generated dialogue or incoherent arcs can disrupt immersion or actively harm player experience, undermining the engagement the system was meant to foster.
claims.source: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)
claims.quote: poorly generated dialogue or incoherent narrative arcs
claims.page: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)

claims.claim: A 10-expert Delphi panel added 'Voice' as a quality dimension because naturalness did not capture tone; a distinctive voice is a critical marker of story quality distinct from plot.
claims.source: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)
claims.quote: a distinctive and compelling narrative voice
claims.page: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)

claims.claim: Producing a hard-boiled detective story when fantasy was requested was rated a must-be failure regardless of technical competence.
claims.source: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)
claims.quote: producing a hard-boiled detective story when a fantasy narrative is requested
claims.page: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)

claims.claim: Even with well-crafted prompts, generated quality varies unpredictably across sessions, with trends toward overly positive or uninspired endings.
claims.source: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)
claims.page: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI (Valdivia & Burelli, ITU Copenhagen; 2025-09-04)

claims.claim: LLMs cannot read a text, form a mental model of it, and then use that model; they only produce babbled text.
claims.source: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)
claims.quote: All they can do is produce a stream of babbled text.
claims.page: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)

claims.claim: In a ChatGPT Lasers & Feelings playtest transcript, the model forgot everyone was aboard ships and turned the attacking pirates into lost travellers within a few turns.
claims.source: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)
claims.quote: ChatGPT momentarily forgets that everyone is onboard ships.
claims.page: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)

claims.claim: 'Hallucination' misdescribes the failure: there is no false model, only a guessed word that matched training patterns and did not conform to reality.
claims.source: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)
claims.quote: It's just words. There is no underlying mental model
claims.page: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)

claims.claim: Individual moments read as good simulacra, but the whole is random babble because a GM's job is to hold and update a canonical model of the world.
claims.source: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)
claims.quote: the totality of the experience is nothing more than random babble
claims.page: The Alexandrian — Thought of the Day: GenAI and RPGs (Justin Alexander, 2025-12-28)
